_doc: Prop-rule facts gathered on 2026-10-30 by web SEARCH from the cloud session. The firms' own websites could not be opened from the cloud (DNS blocked by the environment's network policy), so no fact here is 'verified': status 'uncertain' = consistent across third-party summaries or seen in a search result pointing at the firm's own FAQ, but the page itself was not read. Verify on the official page (get_prop_rules.bat on the PC, then the dashboard's 'Record / verify a rule' form) before any decision.

facts.quote: search summary of the official FAQ: trading bots connected via API are permitted; self-developed, custom and third-party bots permitted; copy trading, account mirroring and external signal providers not allowed; high-frequency strategies not permitted
facts.note: one third-party blog claims only custom-built bots are allowed during the evaluation (conflict)

facts.quote: search summary: copy trading, account mirroring and external signal providers are not allowed
5% daily drawdown; two modes: Standard follows intraday peak equity, Swing fixes the reference at start-of-day equity
facts.note: the mode matters for the simulator (daily_basis); the project preset uses start-of-day equity

facts.quote: 10% maximum loss, static from the initial balance (reviews agree it is not trailing)
a single realized trade loss above 3% of the initial balance can violate the rules
sources disagree on minimum trading days
Martingale and grid trading, cross-account hedging are banned
positions must be closed by 3:10 PM CT; risk managers begin flattening at 3:08 PM CT (described by Topstep as a legacy rule; one 2026 guide says funded accounts may hold overnight)
facts.note: rules reportedly changed four times between 2025-11 and 2026-04

facts.quote: TopstepX API supports automation; legitimate automated strategies permitted; HFT / sim-exploiting automation prohibited; automation must run from a personal device (no VPS / VPN)
several sources: all automated trading must run from a personal device; VPS and VPN usage prohibited
